title: Cylinders in Fano threefolds of genus 9 and 10
summary: We prove that any Fano threefold of genus 9 and 10 contains a cylinder, i.e. an open subset isomorphic to the product of a quasiprojective variety and the affine line. Moreover, we show that any Fano threefold of genus 10 has a point such that the Hilbert scheme of lines through the point has length three.
